Class RecentSignInDecision

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationDecision
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.RecentSignInDecision
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationResult, org.springframework.security.authorization.method.MethodAuthorizationDeniedHandler
public final class RecentSignInDecision extends org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationDecision implements org.springframework.security.authorization.method.MethodAuthorizationDeniedHandler
Whether a caller signed in recently enough, and, when not, how to answer: the exception to throw and, for a bearer token, the step-up challenge to send.

A refused method call throws the answer itself, rather than Spring Security's AuthorizationDeniedException, so that an application advice mapping every AccessDeniedException to 403 still answers a stale sign-in with 401. who's security chains answer a refused URL rule the same way.
